ZerPage.title: Zer
ZerPage.subtitle: Mini ERP for Mongolian SMEs. Inventory, sales, expenses, customers, and reports — all in one system.
ZerPage.features-title: Everything you need to run your business
ZerPage.features-subtitle: From inventory to sales to reporting, Zer handles the complexity of running a Mongolian small business so you don't have to.
ZerPage.feature-1-desc: Track products, categories, units, and stock levels in real time. Automatic stock counts, product codes, price history, and low-stock alerts.
ZerPage.feature-2-desc: Create sales with multi-line entry, customer selection, and payment tracking. Shop POS module with product catalog, cart, checkout, and receipt printing for retail.
ZerPage.feature-3-desc: Log expenses by category, amount, date, and payment method. Monthly expense reports with comparisons and CSV export.
ZerPage.feature-4-desc: Detailed profiles with contact info, balance tracking, and full transaction history for both customers and suppliers.
ZerPage.feature-5-desc: Sales, expense, and profit reports with charts and graphs. Date range filtering, CSV export, and public share links.
ZerPage.feature-6-desc: Manage multiple physical locations with isolated transactions per branch. Consolidated accounting view across all branches.
ZerPage.cta-subtitle: Start free. No credit card required.

TolomPage.title: Tolom
TolomPage.subtitle: Auto repair shop management for Mongolia. Bay view, work orders, parts, estimates, and mechanic tracking — all in one tool.
TolomPage.features-subtitle: From bay view scheduling to final invoicing, Tolom keeps your auto repair shop organized and efficient.
TolomPage.feature-1-desc: Visual bay management with Grid, Kanban, and List views. Drag-and-drop vehicle and mechanic assignment, queue management, and post-service workflows.
TolomPage.feature-2-desc: Full lifecycle management — create, assign, track status transitions, log services and parts used. Complete repair history for every vehicle.
TolomPage.feature-3-desc: Parts catalog with stock management, purchase orders, reorder alerts, and supplier management. Never run out of common parts.
TolomPage.feature-4-desc: Generate quotes (6 views), convert to work orders, create professional invoices, and track payments. Integrated with your accounting.
TolomPage.feature-5-desc: Store vehicle info, full service history, and customer contact details. Plate search, service reminders, and history tracking.
TolomPage.feature-6-desc: Daily reports, clock in/out, work queue, and performance tracking. Assign mechanics to bays and track labor efficiency.
TolomPage.cta-subtitle: Start free. No credit card required.

AboutPage.title: About Zuiio
AboutPage.subtitle: We build software for Mongolian businesses. One brand, two products, one mission — make work easier.
AboutPage.mission-p1: Most business software is built for markets like the US or Europe, then adapted for Mongolia — badly. Tax codes don't match, social insurance rules are wrong, and the language feels translated.
AboutPage.mission-p2: We're changing that. Zuiio products are built from the ground up for Mongolian businesses. Every form, every workflow, every feature — designed for how businesses actually work in Mongolia.
AboutPage.mission-p3: Zer is a mini ERP for SMEs — inventory, sales, expenses, customers, and reports. Tolom manages auto repair shops — bay view, work orders, parts, estimates, and mechanics. Two tools, one philosophy — software that feels like it was made for you.
AboutPage.value-1-desc: We don't adapt software from other markets — we build from the ground up for Mongolian businesses. Tax codes, social insurance, language, and culture.
AboutPage.value-2-desc: Mongolia's internet infrastructure is growing, but it's not everywhere yet. Our products work offline and sync when you reconnect.
AboutPage.value-3-desc: We remove complexity, not features. Every button, every screen, every workflow is designed to make someone's job easier.
AboutPage.value-4-desc: No hidden fees, no surprise charges. You pay for what you use, and you know exactly what you're paying for.
AboutPage.team-desc: A small team passionate about making Mongolian businesses more efficient through great software. We're designers, engineers, and operators who understand the challenges of running a business in Mongolia.
